question: 哪个地区的用户退款数量最多
gold_sql: select r.region_name from refunds r left join orders o on r.order_id = o.order_id left join users u on o.user_id = u.user_id left join regions r on u.region_id = r.region_id group by r.region_name order by count(distinct r.refund_id) desc limit 1
raw_output:
SELECT r.region_name, COUNT(rf.refund_id) AS refund_count
FROM refunds rf
JOIN orders o ON rf.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.user_id
JOIN regions r ON u.region_id = r.region_id
GROUP BY r.region_id, r.region_name
ORDER BY refund_count DESC
LIMIT 1;
pred_sql:
